editorial:
Ever wondered what would happen if you could just erase a mistake from your brain? You get to see that play out here with two business travelers who have a quick, passionate affair. Instead of dealing with the messy drama of cheating or heartbreak, they decide to use a sci-fi shortcut to simply forget each other ever existed. The vibe is a mix of a romantic comedy and a strange science experiment, making you question if ignoring your problems actually makes them go away or if you are just lying to yourself.

You will likely love the chemistry between the leads and how the movie keeps you guessing about the rules of the memory wipe. It moves at a decent clip, though some parts feel a bit slow. If you enjoy quirky stories that blend love with a bit of weird science, you should definitely give this a shot. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a solid choice for a quick movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that erasing memories does not actually erase the feelings. Even though the two main characters tried to wipe their slate clean, their hearts still remember the connection. They eventually realize that the pain and the messiness of their affair were actually important. They decide to stop fighting the truth and embrace their feelings, proving that love is stronger than any machine or memory wipe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a sci-fi twist.
